chat.t: Did you receive the letter?

o: Was it you who threw the kunai?

chat.t: All according to plan.
As soon as you opened the door and saw the flying kunai, you would have dodged to the right.
Then, looking at the mirror in the entryway, you would have thought, "Am I... actually handsome?"
And the moment you turned back to leave, you found the letter placed in front of the door.
And right now, you are typing, "How did you know!"
That, too, was all according to plan.
My name is Kage. A kunoichi belonging to the Umbral Watch, and...
The shadow sword that protects Four Gentlemen.
{player}, your existence has also become known to our Umbral Watch.
Therefore, for the safety of Four Gentlemen,
I shall personally assess your threat level.
Please meet me at the location specified in the letter.
Then the number of kunai you have to dodge when you open the door will increase.
Your threat level has been assessed.
Based on what I have observed from meeting you today...
You are roughly on par with a pill bug.

o: Apologize to me and the pill bug.

chat.t: It is not over yet.
There are still 77 evaluation items remaining.

o: Is that according to plan, too?

chat.t: All according to plan.
Anyway, I shall assess the remaining items next time.
Until then, stay safe.

lines.t: Blossom Garden
I arrived at the meeting spot, but there was no sign of her.

Where on earth is she?
I didn't get stood up, did I?
Right here.

Hmm.
Even your surprise is according to plan.
You say that about everything.

Of course.
Because it is all written down in my notebook.
So, what's your plan from here on?
Hehe.
What's with that mocking laughter?
Did I not tell you? I am going to assess your threat level.
I have already formulated about 31 plans to assess your threat level.
Furthermore, I have already completed threat assessments on 5 items.
Stopping properly at the crosswalk signal, 1 point, helping a pedestrian find their way, 1 point, picking up litter, 1 point...
Did you write all of that down in your notebook?

Ahem!
Only with accurate records can one formulate a proper plan.
Anyway, there are plenty of other items to assess besides these.
So, I ask that you cooperate quietly.
Well, it's not like I can dodge kunai every single morning.
DD STATION
According to my friend, a person's true nature is revealed when they play games.
True enough.
Therefore, I shall test you.

Your deepest feelings...
The truth buried within your abyss!!
A moment later.
Oho, a counter there?
Then try taking this as well!

Ugh, if that's how it's going to be...
I'll hit you with a predictive anti-air!
Then here is a counterattack that goes beyond predicting your prediction.

Not bad!
In that case, I'll predict the prediction of your prediction...!
Heh. Perhaps you should check your health first.

Gh!?
I don't have enough health left to counter!?

Your skills were quite impressive...
But you were still no match for me.
Whew... Let's go again next time, then.
I've only been using twenty percent of my full strength, you know.
I have only used fifteen percent of mine.
I shall test that confidence of yours next time.
By the way, what did we come here to do again?
Why, of course...  Ah!?
We had a lot of fun, didn't we!

A-Ahem!
This, too, was entirely within my plans!
To think you would not reveal your true nature even while gaming. Impressive.
But I did play with my true nature.

Hmph, I shall not be fooled by such words!
This time, for sure...
We shall settle this with this claw machine!!

Heh.
It seems there is a bit of a trick to this.
But against me, Kage, a kunoichi of the Umbral Watch, something of this level is...
This is a scam!!
Is this part of the plan too?

O-Of course.
It is all part of the plan.
Regrettably, we must move on to the next plan...
...Glance.
Want me to get it for you?

W-What?! It is a doll that even I, a kunoichi, could not obtain.
There must be some wicked trickery at play.
It would be nothing more than a waste of money if you tried, so let us...
But I got it.
Here.

Wh-what... I am a kunoichi.
I must not be swayed by something so cute.
If you think you can buy my favor with a bribe...
Should I throw it away, then?
You must not!
Well, it'd be a waste to throw it away, so go ahead and make a plan for what to do with it.

I-I see.
There was such a way.

chat.t: Did you receive my letter?

o: I A L M O S T D I E D

chat.t: It is fine. I threw it with the back of my hand.

o: That's impressive, but it makes no sense.
Just text me next time, don't write letters for no reason.

chat.t: It is not for no reason.
Letters are a time-honored testament of communication.

o: I'm about to write my last testament!

chat.t: That is also in my plans.
Do not worry, as I will have your remaining assets transferred to me.
Dead men tell no tales.

o: I will become a ghost and haunt you.

chat.t: E V I L S P I R I T S B E G O N E
Anyway, the second test is ready, so please come out.

o: Has your assessment of me gone up at all?

chat.t: Yes. Do not be surprised...
It has been upgraded to firefly level.
The point deductions are clear.
To think you would sneeze during infiltration.
Had it been a kunoichi exam, you would have failed.
That is what they all say.
Burying your head in my rear is also a point deduction.
Why are you saying that so openly?
I must raise your threat level. You are now rhinoceros beetle class.
It is not a school grade. Why are you so happy?
We still have evaluation items left, so I shall see you next time.

lines.t: Sky Lantern Street
Sky Lantern Street was crowded with people.
Where is she this time? Surely she's not...
Your back is wide open.
Just now, I had 101 plans that could have assassinated you.
Even with a hundred lives, it wouldn't be enough.

Do not worry.
I shall subtract one as a special service.
That still leaves exactly one hundred!
In any case, that is not what is important.
(She's trying to brush past it again.)
The festival is a highly important event for Four Gentlemen.

Through the festival, we exchange connections and goods, raise our spirits,
and build up our strength to stand against aberrant spirits.

However, because of that...
it is easy for gaps to form.

Negative emotions could explode while bargaining for goods,
or one could simply lose their wallet.
Or someone else might take the cat paw massager prize you had your eye on first...!
Hey, isn't that a bit too specific to be a hypothetical?

I visited fifteen different shops just to enter the raffle...!
That cat burglar...!
So it was based on a true story!

...Anyway, such things can happen.
Thus, we must help the festival run smoothly so that aberrant spirits do not seize the opportunity to appear.
Furthermore, I heard there is an organization showing suspicious movements during this festival.
{player}, you must infiltrate the suspicious ones' hideout with me.
Infiltrate...?
Infiltration is also part of a kunoichi's duties, after all.
Harmony Pavilion

According to the information I gathered...
they are formulating their plans at Harmony Pavilion.
First, let us hide and listen to their plans.
...Finally, the time has come!Dark Gym Member ADark Gym Club
In Four Gentlemen, festivals are sacred ground...Dark Gym Member BDark Gym Club

But we know the truth.
The wicked truth hidden beneath the surface.Dark Gym Member ADark Gym Club

Yes.
And that is...Dark Gym Member BDark Gym Club
The fact that all festival food is greasy!Dark Gym Member ADark Gym Club
Exactly! For those of us who pursue physical beauty, grease is like a deadly poison...Dark Gym Member BDark Gym Club
Because of that, we had to clutch our empty stomachs and tremble in agony every time the greasy smell drifted over...Dark Gym Member BDark Gym Club
But that pain and suffering ends today.Dark Gym Member ADark Gym Club
With this very... Super Protein X!Dark Gym Member ADark Gym Club
Is it finally complete?Dark Gym Member BDark Gym Club

Yes! A forbidden new medicine where eating even a little makes you reject greasy food...
If we secretly slip this into the festival food...Dark Gym Member ADark Gym Club
Hehehe... Everyone's bodies will be ruined so they can't eat anything but healthy food like salad and chicken breast...!Dark Gym Member BDark Gym Club

...Hm.
They seem to be discussing something highly suspicious...
We are too far away to hear clearly.
Please stick close so we are not spotted.
(How am I supposed to stick any closer than this?)

...Um.
Your breathing is rather heavy...
Could you please stop blowing your hot breath on my rear...?
*Pant, pant...*
*Sniff* *sniff*...
W-What do you think you are doing!?
Wh-what is that?!Dark Gym Member ADark Gym Club

Kh...!
At this rate...!
It's a cat!
A c-cat??

Who's there?!
Is it an intruder?Dark Gym Member BDark Gym Club
Kh... It cannot be helped.
M-Meow...
What, is it just a cat?Dark Gym Member ADark Gym Club
That meow sounded a bit strange...Dark Gym Member BDark Gym Club
Meow, meow...meeeow...
Come on, it's just a normal, timid cat.Dark Gym Member ADark Gym Club
Is it? I guess there are cats like that.Dark Gym Member BDark Gym Club

Let's get going, then.
It's time for muscle and protein!Dark Gym Member ADark Gym Club
It's a dog!
A d-dog...?
Could it be... an intruder?!Dark Gym Member BDark Gym Club
W-Woof! Woof!
What, is it just a normal dog?Dark Gym Member ADark Gym Club
Really? A normal dog in a place like this...?Dark Gym Member BDark Gym Club
R-Ruff ruff! Growl... Snarl!
Looks like a crazy dog.Dark Gym Member ADark Gym Club
Then it makes sense for it to be here.Dark Gym Member BDark Gym Club
Alright, let's get moving. From now on, it's time for muscle and protein!Dark Gym Member ADark Gym Club

Whew, I barely managed to divert their attention.
Now...
Whew... Achhoo!
Kyaah?!
What... Who goes there!Dark Gym Member ADark Gym Club

Kh...!
This was not in the plans! What are you doing?!
I couldn't help it, your rear smells so nice.
Are you seriously saying that right now?!

Are you...
assassins sent by Four Gentlemen?!Dark Gym Member BDark Gym Club

I am not an assassin.
I am a kunoichi.
Isn't that the same thing?
It is not.

Hmph, we can't change our plans now...
We'll defeat you and unleash the protein on the festival!Dark Gym Member ADark Gym Club

Formulating a plan is admirable...
But there is a flaw in your plan.
As long as the Umbral Watch stands, and as long as I am here...
Your plans will all be in vain.
Though there were a few issues along the way, we have taken care of the suspicious ones.
{player}, thanks to you, everything seems to have worked out as planned.
But this is not the end.
The festival is still underway, and your threat assessment is not yet complete.

So, would you...
like to go see the festival with me?
Of course, this is strictly a patrol.

chat.t: The time has come.

o: Is it time for the Intermediate Kunoichi Exam?

chat.t: What are you talking about?
Your threat assessment test is ready.
Just what on earth did you study?
There is no such thing in the curriculum.

o: Even the ancient records say the Intermediate Kunoichi Exam includes Bedroom Arts.

chat.t: Why are you making things up?
Stop fooling around.
I have prepared a special mission for today, so please come out.

o: Are we starting the friend assessment today?

chat.t: Indeed.

o: When are you going to raise it?

chat.t: Do not be impatient.
This is all going according to my plan.

o: Did you write it in your notebook?

chat.t: Of course.
To write in it yourself? Absolutely not.
I will not let you snatch my notebook like last time.

o: By the way, when is the next Intermediate Kunoichi Exam?

chat.t: I told you, there is no such exam.

lines.t: Snowsea Hot Springs
Once again, there was no one at the meeting place.

Could it be...
Has it begun!?
Has what begun?
The Intermediate Kunoichi Exam.
I told you, there is no such thing.
*(Sulk)*
Why do you look so disappointed?
So, what is the final test?
If it's mixed bathing at the hot springs, I'm all for it.
...Sigh, actually, it is similar.
The final test is to verify whether you are truly a safe person for Four Gentlemen.

To do so...
I shall test whether you can maintain your reason no matter what temptation you face.
What if I lose my reason?
My kunai will pierce right between your eyes.
Hey.
Do you really think I can resist when someone as charming as you is trying to tempt me?
W-What?!
Wh-what are you talking about?

I am a blade of the shadows, a kunoichi...
Calling me charming does not suit me at all.

This is strictly a mission...
And, well, I only learned how to seduce a target during the basic kunoichi training...
(So they do learn that.)

And honestly, someone like me...
is merely a low-ranking kunoichi...
The mission to investigate you was practically just a side task anyway...
A side task? That's a bit harsh.
Ah, I did not mean that a side task is unimportant.
Four Gentlemen are also keeping an eye on you and the fixers...
And personally, I was interested in you for leading the Panoticon jailbreak plan...
You're interested in me?
Ah!
You should have told me sooner.
No, well... By interest, I literally meant I was just curious...
So, who is tempting whom again?

I mean...  Um, in times like this, my plan is...
This was not in the plans...
My notebook, my notebook...

With ninja-like agility, I snatched the notebook from Kage
as she hurriedly tried to check its contents.
Ah!?
Let's see... 31 plans for the 'Hot Spring Plan'...
Bathing together,  playing board games,  splashing around,  drinking coffee milk...
Wait, give it back!
Sitting side-by-side in massage chairs to talk for twenty minutes, and finally, a perfect game of ping-pong☆
...That's the plan, right?
U-Ugh...

Y-Yes!
That was indeed the plan! Do you have a problem with it?
...If I do not have a plan, I freeze up and cannot move properly...
So I always write down my planned actions in my notebook.
That is why I became interested in you.

The split-second planning and execution
you demonstrated during the retaking of Panoticon...

Having spent time with you, I certainly understand now
how you made it possible.

Furthermore, to think you would snatch my most vital...
my notebook from me.
My plans are in absolute ruins now.
Do... as you wish.
Then let's go with your plan.
Pardon?

It's a great plan.
Looks like a ton of fun.
Th-that is...
My plan is usually to have no plan, but I like things like this too.
I spent time with Kage at the hot springs, following the plan she had laid out.
Ah, that was fun.
See? It was an excellent plan.
But does this mean I fell for your temptation?
You...
Try to make it painless, if you can.
...Fufu.
I really cannot win against you.
Are you letting me live?

How does any part of you look like someone who fell for temptation?
Rather, the one who fell for it was...

...No.
Let us pretend this never happened and call it a draw.
I believe I have sufficiently assessed your threat level with this.
Finally!
You are about firefly level.
That's weaker than a rhinoceros beetle.

It means you are that harmless.
Please take it as a compliment.
So I don't have to worry about getting hit by a kunai every time I leave my house, right?

Of course.
In fact...

Fireflies are guides to kunoichi...
In other words, friends...
From now on, if there is a blade aimed at you...
Kage, the blade of the shadows, shall protect you.
So please do not forget today.
Although I am a blade of the shadows meant to protect Four Gentlemen...
In my heart... you are now there as well.
In your chest, you say?

...Where exactly do you think you are touching?
We may be friends, but I never gave you permission to go that far.
Come on, friends can touch each other a little.
Please do so only after you raise your friend assessment.
There was an assessment for that too!?

Yes, so...
please do your best on the next assessment as well.
